description_summary: Use when a TypeScript starter feature is vague and needs requirements, alternatives or tradeoffs before a plan.
should_trigger: I have a vague idea for session notifications; help explore requirements.
We need better mobile collaboration but have not chosen an approach.
Help compare alternatives for offline session editing before planning.
Explore the scope and tradeoffs of adding document version history.
Interview me about what a session archive feature should accomplish.
should_trigger_test: Capture our feature discussion so a later implementation plan can reuse it.
Research uncertain requirements and return to the feature discussion afterward.
should_not_trigger: Execute the tasks in this existing implementation plan.
Diagnose this Postgres unique constraint failure in a Drizzle repository.
Watch this pull request for new review comments and check results.
Record this reviewed exact package artifact in dependency-vet.json.
Freeze edits to the database package for this investigation.
